digest.title: Scaling Git at OpenAI
digest.tldr: How OpenAI built Pando, a Git-compatible backend designed for the scale of development that Codex makes possible.

digest.title: Rewarding defenders with bigger bug bounties
digest.tldr: OpenAI is raising Security Bug Bounty rewards and introducing report quality, loyalty, and priority campaign bonuses for independent security researchers.

digest.title: Preparing our next security sprint to harden OpenAI
digest.tldr: OpenAI is preparing its next internal security sprint with Cathedral Systems to test and strengthen its defenses using AI.

digest.title: Introducing the Grid Protectors Program
digest.tldr: OpenAI’s Grid Protectors Program will work with utilities to help future compute campuses support grid reliability and protect consumer electricity costs.

digest.title: Anthropic warns that it’s very close to RSI capability, aka self-building AI
digest.tldr: RSI is the point at which AI grows so good at training itself that it spawns a dramatic acceleration of AI capabilities.  To the AI doomers, RSI represents the cataclysm from which there is no return.
